summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long AXTI Daily Target ETF (AXTU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of AXT, Inc. (NASDAQ: AXTI), less fees and expenses. AXTU was launched on May 5, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
